svg.title: AI Vacation Planner: simple architecture and planned monitoring
svg.desc: Current flow: a traveler enters a destination in Streamlit Community Cloud. Streamlit invokes a sequential CrewAI workflow with a research agent and an itinerary agent. The researcher uses Serper web search, and both agents use Amazon Bedrock Nova Pro. The Markdown guide returns to Streamlit for display and download; reporting also writes a local report.md file. GitHub Actions currently runs dependency, Python, mocked application, and credential checks, while Streamlit updates from its connected repository branch. Planned application instrumentation sends request outcomes and duration to CloudWatch Logs. Planned CloudWatch metrics and alarms notify Amazon SNS, which sends alarm and recovery email to a confirmed subscription. A planned Serverless Framework configuration deploys the monitoring resources through CloudFormation. Pink dashed components and links are planned, not deployed. Authentication details are omitted from this overview.
svg.text: Solid blue: current application flow | Dashed pink: planned monitoring and alerts
Sequential process: research findings become report context
Both agents use Amazon Nova Pro
Planned telemetry uses request IDs and operational metadata; credentials and full prompts are omitted.
Current app and CI are implemented. Monitoring, alerts, and the infrastructure configuration are design proposals only.
